Apartment Lease Agreement

This Lease Agreement is made between Harborview Apartments (Landlord) and Jordan Ellis (Tenant) for Unit 4B at 2210 Harborview Drive, Portland, OR 97210. The term begins on March 1, 2025, and ends on February 28, 2026. Rent is $1,850 per month, due on the first. A late fee of $75 applies if payment is not received by the fifth.

The Tenant must provide a security deposit of $2,000. The Landlord will return the deposit within 30 days after the Tenant moves out, minus any deductions for unpaid rent or damage beyond normal wear and tear. The Tenant must give 60 days' written notice before moving out early; otherwise, the Tenant is responsible for rent until the end of the term or until a new tenant is found.

Pets are not allowed without prior written approval. The Tenant must keep the unit clean and report any maintenance issues promptly. The Landlord may enter the unit with 24 hours' notice for inspections or repairs. Any changes to this lease must be made in writing and signed by both parties. The Tenant acknowledges receiving a copy of the building's rules and regulations. By signing below, the Tenant agrees to all terms.

Jordan Ellis (Tenant) Date: February 10, 2025
Harborview Apartments (Landlord) Date: February 10, 2025

Thank you for choosing GreenDrive Car Rental. Your reservation for a compact car from June 5 to June 12 is confirmed. The total estimated cost is $315, including taxes and fees. Please bring your driver's license and a credit card in your name to the pickup counter at Terminal 2. The rental includes unlimited mileage, but additional drivers must be added at the counter for a fee of $10 per day. Fuel is not included; return the car with the same fuel level to avoid refueling charges. If you need to modify or cancel your reservation, please do so at least 24 hours before pickup to avoid a $50 fee. We look forward to serving you.

Expense Claim Policy Reminder: All employees must submit expense claims within 30 days of the expense date. Claims must include itemized receipts and a brief business justification. The Finance team uses an automated tool to scan receipts and flag any missing information, so please double-check before submitting. If your claim is rejected, you can resubmit with corrections. For travel expenses, economy class is required for flights under six hours. Meals are reimbursed up to $50 per day with receipts. Non-compliant claims may be delayed or denied. If you have questions, contact the Finance Helpdesk at finance@northstar-tech.com.

Frequently Asked Questions About Your Lease

Q: Can I have a roommate? A: Yes, but all occupants must be listed on the lease. Adding a roommate requires a background check and a $100 application fee. The new occupant must sign a lease addendum.

Q: What happens if I need to break my lease early? A: You must provide 60 days' written notice and pay an early termination fee equal to two months' rent. Alternatively, you may sublet with the Landlord's approval, but you remain responsible for the rent.

Q: How do I request maintenance? A: Submit a maintenance request through the online portal. For emergencies (e.g., flooding, no heat), call the emergency line at (555) 123-4567. Non-emergency requests are typically addressed within 3-5 business days.

Q: Can I install a satellite dish? A: No, satellite dishes are not permitted. However, you may use streaming services. The building provides free Wi-Fi in common areas.

Q: Is renters insurance required? A: Yes, you must provide proof of renters insurance with at least $100,000 in liability coverage before moving in.

When you pick up your rental car, inspect it thoroughly for any existing damage and take photos. Report any issues to the rental agent before driving off. The car should be returned with a full tank of gas; if not, refueling charges of $8 per gallon will apply. Toll charges are your responsibility, and an admin fee of $5 per toll will be added if we process them. If you have an accident, call the police and our 24/7 emergency line immediately. Do not leave the scene until an officer arrives. Our chatbot is available on the website for non-urgent questions, but for immediate assistance, call us.

Common Expense Claim Mistakes to Avoid

Submitting an expense claim can be straightforward if you avoid these common errors. First, missing receipts are the top reason for rejection. Always attach legible, itemized receipts. Second, using the wrong category can delay processing. For example, meals should be categorized as 'Meals & Entertainment,' not 'Travel.' Third, exceeding policy limits without prior approval will result in partial reimbursement. If you need to exceed a limit, get approval from your manager before the expense.

Another frequent mistake is submitting claims after the 30-day deadline. The finance team may make exceptions for extenuating circumstances, but you must include a written explanation. Also, ensure that your bank details are up to date in the expense system; otherwise, reimbursement may fail. The system uses an automated assistant to validate bank information, so incorrect details will trigger a notification.

Finally, remember that personal expenses should never be claimed. If you accidentally include a personal item, remove it before submission. The finance team conducts random audits, and violations may lead to disciplinary action. If you're unsure about a claim, ask your manager or the finance helpdesk before submitting. For more details, refer to the Employee Handbook section 4.3.
Need to update your payment method for your car rental? Log in to your account and go to 'Billing' to add or change your credit card. Changes must be made before the rental period begins.

Expense Claim Form Instructions: Please fill out all fields accurately. Use the 'Add Item' button to list each expense separately. Attach receipts by clicking 'Upload' and selecting the file. If you need to delete an item, click the trash icon next to it. For mileage claims, enter the total miles and the system will calculate reimbursement at the current IRS rate. Once submitted, you cannot edit the claim; contact the finance team if changes are needed. The admin team reviews claims within five business days. You will receive an email notification when your claim is processed.

During your rental period, you are responsible for parking tickets and toll violations. If you receive a ticket, pay it promptly to avoid late fees. We will charge an administrative fee of $25 for each violation we process. If you need to extend your rental, contact us at least 24 hours before the return time. Extensions are subject to availability and additional charges. Our virtual assistant can help with extension requests on our website, but you must confirm by phone. Thank you for choosing GreenDrive.

Understanding Your Security Deposit

Your security deposit is held to cover any unpaid rent or damage beyond normal wear and tear. Normal wear and tear includes minor scuffs, small nail holes, and worn carpet. Damage includes broken windows, large stains, or missing fixtures. Within 30 days of move-out, we will provide an itemized list of deductions and return the remaining deposit.

To ensure a full refund, clean the apartment thoroughly and remove all personal belongings. Patch small nail holes and touch up paint if needed. If you have questions about what constitutes normal wear and tear, refer to the move-out checklist provided at move-in. Our office assistant can provide a copy if you've misplaced yours.

If you disagree with deductions, you may dispute them in writing within 15 days of receiving the itemized list. We will review your dispute and respond within 10 business days. If we cannot resolve the issue, we may use a mediation service. The cost of mediation will be shared equally. Note that the deposit cannot be used as last month's rent unless explicitly agreed upon in writing.
